listingTitle: Avoid repeated JavaScript array membership scans
title: Avoid repeated JavaScript array membership scans
why: Array includes and indexOf scan linearly, so using them inside another loop can produce quadratic work.
suggestion: Build a Set before the loop when repeated membership checks dominate and array ordering is not required for lookup.
limitations: Only variables with an array type annotation or array-literal assignment used with includes or indexOf in braced loops are reported.
Collection size, reassignment, variable shadowing, and intentionally small arrays are not inferred.
